optimizedContext.value:
# Schema Format
## Rules
### File structure
- Top-level: `kind` (schema|schema-plugin), `name`, `version`, optional `description`/`extends`/`compat`, `artifacts` (required for schema), optional `crossArtifactValidations`/`workflow`/`metadataExtraction`.
### Kind / extends / compat
- `schema`: full. `schema-plugin`: MUST NOT `artifacts`/`workflow`/`extends`/`compat`; MAY `validations`/`deltaValidations`/`preHashCleanup`/`taskCompletionCheck`/`crossArtifactValidations`/`metadataExtraction`.
- Omit kind → SchemaValidationError. Extends chains root→leaf merge; cycles → SchemaValidationError (by resolved path).
- `compat`: optional string ref (`@specd/schema-std@1`, `schema-std@1`, `schema-std`) or `{ name, version? }`; omitted version → `1`. `Schema.compat()` → `SchemaCompatIdentity|{undefined}`. `Schema.canonicalSpecSchema()` → compat else parse extends else `{ name, version }`.
### Array entry identity
- `id` on hooks, validations, deltaValidations, rules.pre/post, preHashCleanup, crossArtifactValidations, metadataExtraction array entries. Format `^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(-[a-z0-9]+)*$`, 1–64.
- Hooks globally unique across ALL workflow steps. Others unique within immediate array. Workflow identity = `step`; participant local id = `as`.
### Artifact definition
- Required: `id`, `scope` (spec|change), `output`. Optional: `optional` (default false), `hasTasks` (default false; master switch for tasks), `template`, `instruction`, `requires`, `format` (markdown|json|yaml|plaintext; else infer ext), `delta` (spec-only), `deltaInstruction`, `deltaValidations`, `validations`, `metadataExtraction`, `rules.pre/post` (`{id,instruction}` wrap instruction), `preHashCleanup` (`{id,pattern,replacement}` ordered), `taskCompletionCheck`.
- `delta:true` + `scope:change` → SchemaValidationError. Filename from last literal glob segment or template; else SchemaValidationError.
- `requires` resolved when status `complete`|`skipped` (`skipped` only optional). `scope:spec` non-optional → expected in every specs dir + change; `scope:change` never synced.
### artifactDag()
- Canonical API from `requires` only: `roots`, `childrenOf`, `topologicalOrder`, `descendantsOf`. Cached per Schema. Consumers MUST use `schema.artifactDag()` — no parallel rebuilds. `artifactDagFromChangeArtifacts` tests-only when schema available.
### Validations / deltaValidations
- Selector fields (core:selector-model) XOR `path` (JSONPath). Plus `required` (zero-match only), `count` (exactly/min/max/unique.by), `contentMatches`, `children`. deltaValidations same vs delta YAML AST; only when `delta:true`.
### Cross-artifact validations
- `id`, `scope`, `participants` (artifact/as/selector/keySelector?/key), `relation` (`kind`: all-equal|subset|superset, `between`, optional `options.ordering` ignore|strict). Same-scope artifacts only. Keys not raw AST.
### Metadata extraction
- Field → MetadataExtractorEntry: artifact + extractor (selector, extract, capture, strip, groupBy, transform, fields). Transform via runtime registry. dependsOn: label value + href args. Fail normalize explicitly. Fields: title/description/dependsOn/keywords + rules/constraints/scenarios/context arrays.
### Workflow / external hooks
- `step`, optional `requires`, `requiresTaskCompletion` (MUST hasTasks:true), `hooks.pre/post`. External hooks: `id` + `external.type` + `external.config`; unknown type rejected.
### Schema resolution / load
- `@scope/name` npm; `#workspace:name`; `#name`/bare → default workspace; path direct. Missing file → null (caller → SchemaNotFoundError). Zod validate; unknown top-level ignored.
### verify.md / approval
- WHEN/THEN under `### Requirement:` mirroring spec. Schema verify should `requires: [spec]`. Specs touched by delta need per-spec approval before archive.
### Templates
- `template` path relative to schema dir; content plain text, no interpolation; HTML comments preserved.
### taskCompletionCheck
- Meaningful only with `hasTasks:true`. Defaults: incomplete `^\s*-\s+\[ \]`, complete `^\s*-\s+\[[xX]\]`.
## Constraints
- kind required. Plugin MUST NOT artifacts/workflow/extends/compat.
- artifact.id `/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/`; scope required no default; optional default false.
- Non-optional depends on optional forbidden; requires acyclic; workflow step unique.
- deltaValidations only with delta:true. Workflow order = display only (not sequential block).
- Delta format/selectors/apply → core:delta-format.
